title: SOR2 New Era shared value types
description: Value types shared by the entity, level, and pack schemas. Mirrors the Newtonsoft-serialized C# structs in Sor2NewEra.Gameplay.

intVector2.title: IntVector2Model
intVector2.description: Integer 2D vector. In loadcue positions, x is horizontal and y is depth (further from the camera as it grows).

intVector3.title: IntVector3Model
intVector3.description: Integer 3D vector. In velocity and acceleration events, x is horizontal, y is vertical (jump axis), z is depth.

intRect2.title: IntRect2Model
intRect2.description: Integer rectangle in pixels, relative to the entity pivot. Positive y is upwards.

boundingBox.title: BoundingBox
boundingBox.description: Body volume in pixels. The box spans -halfWidth..+halfWidth horizontally, 0..height vertically from the feet, and +/-depth on the depth axis.

x.description: Computed property written by older builds of the tools. The runtime ignores it; do not write it in new files.

y.description: Computed property written by older builds of the tools. The runtime ignores it; do not write it in new files.

multiplier.title: Multiplier
multiplier.description: Deterministic rational multiplier. The game uses integer maths, so ratios are stored as a fraction rather than a float.

audioChannel.title: Audio channel slot
audioChannel.description: Which audio slot the sound plays on. Sounds on the same slot cut each other off, so different slots let sounds overlap. 0 sfx, 1 sfxBgm, 2 voice and 3 prioritary are the named slots from AudioEffect.Channel, but the runtime treats the value as a plain index and creates however many slots it needs, so any non-negative number is a valid private channel.

packName.description: Name of the content pack that owns the referenced asset, or its id (see config.json id), which survives a rename of that pack. An empty string or an omitted value means the Classic pack for loadcues and dependencies, and the current pack for editor-written sound and script references.

scriptData.title: ScriptData
scriptData.description: Reference to a Lua file under the owning pack's Scripts/ folder.

scriptName.description: Script file name relative to the owning pack's Scripts/ folder. The .lua extension is optional and is appended when missing, so "Block" and "Block.lua" both resolve to Scripts/Block.lua.

IsValid.description: Editor artifact written by some older editor builds. The runtime ignores it; do not write it in new files.

combatBounds.title: CombatBounds
combatBounds.description: Canonical facing-relative pixel bounds for all custom hitboxes and hurtboxes. X points right for the right-facing pose, height points up from the feet, and depth follows the belt plane. X mirrors automatically on left-facing poses. Bounds are inclusive; zero dimensions are valid lines/points. Disabled entries suppress collisions for their active duration.

regions.description: Optional disjoint hurt regions sharing the entity origin. The outer bounds remain the world/grab envelope; only the regions can receive hits. An empty array is invulnerable. Applies to hurtboxes, not attack boxes.

legacyHeightRules.description: Migration metadata emitted only for unchanged legacy bodyboxes; preserves the original body collision rules. Do not set on new geometry.

legacyHitRules.description: Migration metadata emitted only for unchanged legacy hitboxes; preserves the original line and inherited depth rules. Do not set on new geometry.
